title: Generation and Purification of pTXB1.Tn5
author: Ryan Mulqueen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6kthcwn
materials: Extract plasmid using Qiagen Miniprep spin column following manufacturer's instructions.
Dialyze against 1 L of Dialysis buffer for 02:00:00 to 03:00:00 in a cold room.4 We use a Slide-a-Lyzer G2 cassettes with 10 KDa cutoff (ThermoFisher, No. 87731).
Extract plasmid using Qiagen Miniprep spin column following manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Prepare LB agar plates
steps.instruction: Make LB agar plates containing 100 µg/mL carbenicillin following the Addgene protocol.

steps.title: Streak glycerol stock
steps.instruction: Streak the glycerol stock of E. coli carrying pTXB1‑Tn5 onto the prepared plates and incubate overnight at 30 °C.

steps.title: Create glycerol stock
steps.instruction: Grow the strain and prepare a long‑term storage stock in 25 % (v/v) glycerol in cryovial tubes; store at –80 °C indefinitely.

steps.title: Inoculate starter culture
steps.instruction: Pick a single colony with a sterile pipette tip, inoculate 5 mL LB + 100 µg/mL carbenicillin, and incubate shaking overnight at 30 °C.

steps.title: Scale up culture
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL of the overnight starter culture to 1 L LB + 100 µg/mL carbenicillin in a 2 L Erlenmeyer flask; incubate with shaking at 30 °C.

steps.title: Transform expression host
steps.instruction: Transform T7 Express LysY (NEB C3031) cells with the extracted pTXB1‑Tn5 plasmid.

steps.title: Grow to induction density
steps.instruction: Grow the transformed culture to OD₆₀₀ = 0.4–0.5 (≈4 h) at 30 °C with shaking, then cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Induce protein expression
steps.instruction: Add IPTG to a final concentration of 0.1 mM (1 mL of 100 mM stock) and incubate overnight at 18–22 °C with mild shaking.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture in 500 mL bottles using a JA‑10 rotor for 25 min at 4 °C; decant supernatant and keep pellets on ice (or freeze at –80 °C for up to 1 week).

steps.title: Resuspend pellets
steps.instruction: Resuspend each pellet in 75 mL ice‑cold HEGX buffer containing 3 tablets of EDTA‑free protease inhibitor in a 100 mL beaker; keep at 4 °C.

steps.title: Sonicate lysate
steps.instruction: Sonicate on ice for a total of 15 min: 30 cycles of 15 s pulse at 14 W followed by 15 s pause; remove stir bar before sonication and avoid foaming.

steps.title: Stir lysate
steps.instruction: Add a sterile magnetic stir bar and stir the lysate on a stir plate at 4 °C to break up remaining material.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Spin the lysate at 4 °C for 30 min in two 50 mL Oak Ridge tubes using a JA‑16 or JA‑20 rotor; keep tubes balanced.

steps.title: Save sample for SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Aliquot 30 µL of the supernatant for a future protein gel; transfer the remaining supernatant to a clean 100 mL beaker with a stir bar.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA
steps.instruction: While stirring, add 2 mL of 5 % (v/v) poly(ethyleneimine) solution dropwise down the sides of the beaker; the solution will become cloudy.

steps.title: Remove precipitated DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the mixture at 4 °C for 10 min in two 50 mL tubes (JA‑16/JA‑20 rotor); keep tubes balanced.

steps.title: Collect Tn5 lysate
steps.instruction: Aliquot 30 µL of supernatant for SDS‑PAGE; transfer the remainder (Tn5 lysate) to a clean 500 mL beaker on ice and bring the volume to 150 mL with ice‑cold HEGX buffer.

steps.title: Set up chitin column
steps.instruction: Clamp a Kimble‑Chase Flex‑Column (30 cm length, 1 cm ID) with two 3‑way valve stop‑cocks in the cold room for gravity flow.

steps.title: Pack chitin resin
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL of chitin resin to the column using a 10 mL serological pipette; allow the resin to settle and pack.

steps.title: Equilibrate column
steps.instruction: Pass 200 mL HEGX buffer through the resin by gravity flow; discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Load lysate onto column
steps.instruction: Load the 150 mL Tn5 lysate onto the column by gravity flow; save the flow‑through for later SDS‑PAGE analysis.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Wash the column with 200 mL HEGX buffer by gravity flow; discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Collect initial eluate
steps.instruction: Collect 9 mL of flow‑through from the column (first eluate).

steps.title: Dialyze protein
steps.instruction: Exchange buffer by dialyzing the eluate against 1 L fresh dialysis buffer overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Measure protein concentration
steps.instruction: Measure absorbance at 280 nm; the expected A₂₈₀ is ≈ 4.0.

steps.title: Check purity by SDS‑PAGE
steps.instruction: Aliquot 30 µL of the dialyzed protein for SDS‑PAGE; run gels for samples taken at steps 20, 23, 27 and 34 (as indicated in the protocol).

steps.title: Add glycerol for storage
steps.instruction: Add approximately 6 mL sterile 100 % glycerol to reach a final glycerol concentration of 55 % (≈15 mL total volume); aliquot into cryotubes and store at –20 °C (stable ≥1 year).

steps.title: Incubate column with HEGX/DTT
steps.instruction: Leave the column containing HEGX/DTT solution in the cold room for 48–72 h.

steps.title: Seal column
steps.instruction: Close and cap both stop‑cocks (including the top stop‑cock) to prevent leakage.

steps.title: Elute with HEGX/DTT (first)
steps.instruction: Open the bottom stop‑cock and allow 11 mL of HEGX containing 100 mM DTT to flow through into a 15 mL Falcon tube; measure the volume.

steps.title: Elute with HEGX/DTT (second)
steps.instruction: Add 24 mL of HEGX with 100 mM DTT to the top of the column using a 25 mL serological pipette.

steps.title: Final column elution
steps.instruction: Allow all wash buffer to drain through the column and then close the bottom stop‑cock.
